item.title: Nigerian lady melts hearts as she celebrates convocation at late father's grave
item.description: A young Nigerian lady grabbed the attention of many Nigerians as she visited her late father’s grave on her convocation day to celebrate her graduation with him.

item.title: Third time's a charm: Emir Sanusi embarks on law degree adventure, details emerge
item.description: Emir Sanusi II expresses joy in learning, highlighting his pursuit of a law degree as a lifelong ambition and the importance of education for all.

item.title: Stakeholders lauds Tinubu’s minister over Nigeria’s educational strides
item.description: Educational stakeholders praise Tunji Alausa for reforming Nigeria’s education sector, expanding vocational training, reducing costs, and enhancing exam integrity.

item.title: Senegal goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf reveals what transpired between him and Moroccan ballboys during AFCON final
item.description: Senegal's goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf recounts his tussle with Moroccan ballboys over Édouard Mendy's towels during the controversial AFCON 2025 final.

item.title: NCAN announces Nigeria’s cashew export, advises Tinubu's govt on reforms
item.description: Nigeria's cashew exports rise to 600,000 metric tonnes annually, driven by tree planting initiatives and calls for processing loans to enhance local value addition.

item.title: CAF removes Senegal's top official from committee after AFCON final win vs Morocco
item.description: CAF removes Senegalese official amid Morocco's protest over the 2025 AFCON final. Tensions rise after Senegal's controversial walkout during the match.

item.title: NAFDAC's new policy threatens 5 million jobs, industry leaders protest
item.description: Concerns arise over NAFDAC's ban on alcohol sachets, jeopardising indigenous industries, jobs, and investment, as the union attacks the policy amid protests.

item.title: NNPP chieftain explains why Tinubu will struggle to win the 2027 election
item.description: Buba Galadima warns that President Tinubu will lose the 2027 election under fair conditions, citing public dissatisfaction and farmers' discontent with his policies.

item.title: 2027 election: Abia Governor, Otti, told to immediately resign from Labour Party, join APC, see reason
item.description: Ahead of the 2027 elections, Abia Governor Otti has been urged to resign from the Labour Party and join the APC, with the reasons behind the move now shared.

item.title: AFCON 2025: Chelsea player enjoys “charmed career” recognition as Senegal claims glory
item.description: A Chelsea star’s "charmed career" has been highlighted following Senegal’s dramatic victory over hosts Morocco at the recently concluded AFCON 2025.
